analyst.summary: KRBL is the world's largest branded basmati rice exporter (India Gate), with a debt-free balance sheet and a full year of strong profit growth (+36%) that cooled somewhat in the most recent quarter. The stock trades cheaply relative to its category leadership and cash generation. On balance we rate it a Hold: the valuation already compensates for the modest returns on equity, and the underlying business remains debt-free and profitable, even as growth momentum has slowed into year-end.
